cards.back:
To travel to a new place to learn about it.
Bahasa Indonesia: menjelajahi
Example: Children love to explore caves and forests.
cards.say: explore. Children love to explore caves and forests.

cards.back:
A person who travels to learn about new places.
Bahasa Indonesia: penjelajah
Example: The explorer drew maps of the unknown land.
cards.say: explorer. The explorer drew maps of the unknown land.

cards.back:
An organised journey made for a special purpose.
Bahasa Indonesia: ekspedisi
Example: The expedition to the mountain took ten days.
cards.say: expedition. The expedition to the mountain took ten days.

cards.back:
A long journey by sea or in space.
Bahasa Indonesia: pelayaran
Example: The voyage across the ocean lasted six weeks.
cards.say: voyage. The voyage across the ocean lasted six weeks.

cards.back:
To find the way to a place.
Bahasa Indonesia: bernavigasi
Example: Sailors navigate by using the stars.
cards.say: navigate. Sailors navigate by using the stars.

cards.back:
One of the seven very large areas of land on Earth.
Bahasa Indonesia: benua
Example: Asia is the largest continent in the world.
cards.say: continent. Asia is the largest continent in the world.

cards.back:
The way you take to get from one place to another.
Bahasa Indonesia: rute
Example: We chose the shortest route to the village.
cards.say: route. We chose the shortest route to the village.

cards.back:
An exciting and unusual experience.
Bahasa Indonesia: petualangan
Example: Our camping trip was a real adventure.
cards.say: adventure. Our camping trip was a real adventure.

cards.back:
A team of people who work together on a ship.
Bahasa Indonesia: awak kapal
Example: The crew worked hard to steer the ship.
cards.say: crew. The crew worked hard to steer the ship.

cards.back:
The leader of a ship or an aeroplane.
Bahasa Indonesia: kapten
Example: The captain gave orders to the crew.
cards.say: captain. The captain gave orders to the crew.

cards.back:
To travel on water in a boat.
Bahasa Indonesia: berlayar
Example: They sail across the sea every summer.
cards.say: sail. They sail across the sea every summer.

cards.back:
To make a home in a new place.
Bahasa Indonesia: menetap
Example: Many families came to settle near the river.
cards.say: settle. Many families came to settle near the river.

cards.back:
An area of land that belongs to someone.
Bahasa Indonesia: wilayah
Example: The explorers entered a territory they had never seen.
cards.say: territory. The explorers entered a territory they had never seen.

cards.back:
Belonging to a place from the beginning.
Bahasa Indonesia: asli
Example: The native people knew the forest well.
cards.say: native. The native people knew the forest well.

cards.back:
To buy, sell or swap goods.
Bahasa Indonesia: berdagang
Example: Long ago, sailors would trade spices for cloth.
cards.say: trade. Long ago, sailors would trade spices for cloth.

cards.back:
Goods carried by a ship or aeroplane.
Bahasa Indonesia: muatan
Example: The ship carried a cargo of spices.
cards.say: cargo. The ship carried a cargo of spices.

cards.back:
A collection of gold, jewels or other valuable things.
Bahasa Indonesia: harta karun
Example: The pirates hid their treasure on a small island.
cards.say: treasure. The pirates hid their treasure on a small island.

cards.back:
The land next to the sea.
Bahasa Indonesia: pantai
Example: The ship travelled along the coast for days.
cards.say: coast. The ship travelled along the coast for days.

cards.back:
To stay alive in a difficult place.
Bahasa Indonesia: bertahan hidup
Example: The explorers had to survive in the cold.
cards.say: survive. The explorers had to survive in the cold.

cards.back:
The food and tools that people need for a trip.
Bahasa Indonesia: perbekalan
Example: They packed enough supplies for the long walk.
cards.say: supplies. They packed enough supplies for the long walk.

cards.back:
Very old, from a time long ago.
Bahasa Indonesia: kuno
Example: The explorers found an ancient temple in the jungle.
cards.say: ancient. The explorers found an ancient temple in the jungle.

cards.back:
A strong-tasting plant part used to flavour food.
Bahasa Indonesia: rempah
Example: Traders sailed far to buy pepper and other spice.
cards.say: spice. Traders sailed far to buy pepper and other spice.

cards.back:
A detailed map of the sea used for sailing.
Bahasa Indonesia: peta laut
Example: The captain studied the chart before sailing.
cards.say: chart. The captain studied the chart before sailing.

cards.back:
To find something for the first time.
Bahasa Indonesia: menemukan
Example: Columbus wanted to discover a new trade route.
cards.say: discover. Columbus wanted to discover a new trade route.
